problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign parcels to identical delivery trucks. Parcels:
* Parcel 1: size 70 cubic feet
* Parcel 2: size 38 cubic feet
* Parcel 3: size 40 cubic feet
* Parcel 4: size 37 cubic feet
* Parcel 5: size 37 cubic feet
* Parcel 6: size 54 cubic feet
* Parcel 7: size 55 cubic feet
* Parcel 8: size 67 cubic feet
* Parcel 9: size 59 cubic feet
* Parcel 10: size 38 cubic feet
* Parcel 11: size 65 cubic feet
* Parcel 12: size 49 cubic feet
* Parcel 13: size 52 cubic feet
* Parcel 14: size 70 cubic feet
* Parcel 15: size 60 cubic feet
* Parcel 16: size 56 cubic feet

Each truck can carry up to 100 cubic feet of cargo. Assign all parcels using the fewest trucks. Each parcel must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total cargo volume in a truck cannot exceed its capacity.
